content.value_statement: Guts node deployments need repeatable infrastructure across local, test, and production targets. This skill provides Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes patterns for consistent node rollout.
actual_capabilities: Outlines a Terraform module layout for network, compute, and storage resources.
Provides a Terraform AWS instance pattern for multiple Guts nodes.
Shows a multi-stage Dockerfile structure for building and running a Guts node.
Defines a Docker Compose pattern for three local peer nodes.
Provides a Kubernetes StatefulSet pattern with persistent storage.
Lists monitoring and security checklist items for production readiness.
limitations: Examples are templates and need environment-specific values before deployment.
The Terraform sample is AWS-oriented and not a full cloud-agnostic module.
The skill does not provision infrastructure or run deployment commands.
Security controls are checklist items, not complete policy manifests.

use_cases.title: Plan Local Node Testing
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable Docker Compose layout for a small Guts peer network.

use_cases.title: Design Cloud Infrastructure
use_cases.description: Map Terraform modules and node resources before building environment-specific stacks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Kubernetes Rollout
use_cases.description: Draft StatefulSet, storage, monitoring, and security requirements for production nodes.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Terraform Modules
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design Terraform modules for dev, staging, and production Guts environments.

prompt_templates.title: Review Kubernetes Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review a Kubernetes StatefulSet plan for Guts node persistence and networking.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Production Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a production readiness checklist covering monitoring, TLS, secrets, RBAC, and scanning.

output_examples.input: Plan a local Guts node test network.
output_examples.output: A three-node Docker Compose design with peer settings, persistent volumes, and separate API ports.
A StatefulSet plan with stable node identity, persistent data storage, API and peer ports, and production security tasks.

output_examples.input: Outline Terraform structure for Guts nodes.
output_examples.output: A module-based layout separating network, compute, storage, and environment folders for dev, staging, and production.

best_practices: Replace sample image names, regions, and instance sizes with approved environment values.
Pin container images and base images before production use.
Add TLS, network policies, secrets management, RBAC, and vulnerability scanning.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy sample manifests unchanged into production.
Do not store node secrets directly in Docker Compose or Kubernetes files.
Do not use shared persistent volumes for independent node data.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy infrastructure automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns and checklists that users adapt before running their own deployment tools.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Docker Compose, Terraform, Kubernetes, and common monitoring tools for Guts node deployments.

faq.question: Is the Terraform example cloud agnostic?
faq.answer: No. The shown compute example uses AWS concepts, while the overall structure can guide other providers.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists TLS, network policies, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and RBAC as required checks.

faq.question: What should I change before production use?
faq.answer: Set real environment values, pin images, complete security policies, and validate storage and networking requirements.
